title: Make your own
goal: Add a new shape from the list or the parts on the side.

steps.say: Point at circle. This one is drawn for you already.
On a new line start typing rect, then pick it from the list.
Or drag a box out of the parts on the side of the screen.
Point at left to slide the box sideways into place.
Your picture should have a circle and a box, like the target.
